start: ^This project marked my very first leadership role.
^I managed a 10-member team, coordinating across our art, audio, programming, design, and UI sub-teams to ensure we delivered a solid project.
^Want to hear about my approach to directing the team?
technical_detail: ^Stepping into a leadership role means having to deal with a lot of non-development stuff.
^Just making sure the team glues well together and putting out fires where they happen, you know?
^However, having deep development experience myself was critical.
^Because I spent years as a solo game developer, I had enough foundational knowledge across art, audio, and code to speak with everyone on my team.
^This multi-disciplinary background let me accurately estimate technical timelines, respect my team members' workloads, and scope the features for a project.
^Thanks to that balance, our project was delivered fully polished and became the highest-rated experience at our university technology showcase!
